title: Solar rotation anchor row
description: One internal/surface rotation anchor of the Sun. Covers the Snodgrass-Ulrich surface differential-rotation evaluations (equator/pole) and the helioseismically-inverted interior anchors (tachocline shear + near-rigid radiative interior). Required fields are the ones every anchor shares (region, sidereal_period_days, regime, source_doi, source_published_date, entered_locally_at). radius_r_sun / latitude_deg are populated where the anchor type supplies them.

radius_r_sun.description: Fractional solar radius of the anchor (1.0 = photosphere, ~0.70 = tachocline). Null for a surface-only latitude anchor where the radius is implicitly 1.0 but not the discriminating coordinate.

latitude_deg.description: Heliographic latitude of a surface anchor (0 = equator, 90 = pole). Null for interior anchors where rotation is read as a radial profile, not a latitude one.

sidereal_period_days.description: Local sidereal rotation period in days. The Sun's photosphere ranges ~24.5 d (equator) to ~34 d (pole); the interior settles near ~27 d.

regime.description: Dynamical regime of the anchor. differential_convection_zone = latitude-dependent surface/CZ rotation; shear_boundary = the thin tachocline; rigid_body = the near-rigid radiative interior.

source_key.description: Short citation key into the module SOURCES dict (e.g., 'snodgrass_ulrich_1990', 'schou_1998'). Redundant with source_doi; retained for cross-linking the per-row source to the module's full citation string.

source_doi.description: DOI of the peer-reviewed paper authorising this row's numerical values. Required by the literature_curated adapter for per-row attestation.

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 date the cited paper was published. 'YYYY', 'YYYY-MM', or 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Curator-authored from the cited DOI's metadata; aligns with Dublin Core dcterms:issued. Distinct from attestation.retrieved_at.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date this row was first added or last meaningfully amended. Curator-authored; aligns with Dublin Core dcterms:dateAccessioned.

source_version.description: Optional version/edition tag where it matters; null for journal papers whose DOI fully resolves the version.

notes.description: Per-row free-text notes — derivation context, measurement caveats, cross-references to the rotation closure or the Sun Dynamical Spectrum.
